header.title: Radio
header.description: Lets users pick a single option among several. Use it standalone (several Radio controls with the same `name`) or inside RadioGroup, which passes down `size`, `tone`, state and `name`.

header.title: Radio API
header.description: API reference for the Radio React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath, which also exports RadioGroup.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, Radio accepts native <input> attributes (InputHTMLAttributes) except size, type and children. They go to the <input type="radio">; use wrapperClassName for the container. Inside RadioGroup, the group sets name, size, tone, and the checked and disabled state.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.native: Uses a native <input type="radio">: arrow keys move the selection between radios sharing the same name.
a11y.label: The label wraps the input. With no visible label, pass aria-label.
a11y.group: Inside RadioGroup it inherits aria-invalid and required from the group.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on props. Useful for styling with CSS.

rules.label: <label> element wrapping the control and text.
rules.control: Container for the input and the visual circle.
rules.dot: Inner dot of the checked state.
rules.tone: Applied when `tone="{{value}}"` (or error when the group is invalid).
rules.invalid: Applied when the parent RadioGroup is invalid.
rules.disabled: Applied with `isDisabled`, disabled or a disabled group.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Each tone sets these variables. Redefine them on your `wrapperClassName` to change colors without overriding rules.

items.--gem-radio-tone: Border and background of the checked state.
items.--gem-radio-tone-active: Border and background on hover while checked.
items.--gem-radio-on: Dot color over the checked background.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers. Includes the RadioGroup types.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <input> attributes (except size, type and children).

items.label: Visible label next to the control.
items.name: Native group name. Inside RadioGroup the group sets it.
items.size: Control size. Inherited from RadioGroup when nested.
items.tone: Color tone. Inherited from RadioGroup when nested (error when invalid).
items.isDisabled: Disables the option. Prefer it over native disabled.
items.id: Input id. Inside RadioGroup it is built from `name` and `value`.
items.aria-label: Accessible name when there is no label.
items.className: Extra classes for the native input.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Fires when the option is selected.
